###Plan

We need to find a pattern that relates $x$ to $y$.

The terms in sequence $y$ are $\redE{?}$ more or $\redE{?}$ less than the terms in sequence $x$.

$y = x +{\redE{?}}$

or

$y = x - {\redE{?}}$

We see that $y$ is *less* than $x$ in every row, so we subtract to get $y$.

$x$ | $y$ | Sum
:-: | :-: | :-:
$32$ | $34$ |$32 \redE{+{?}} =34$
$25$ | $27$ |$25 \redE{+{?}} =27$
$18$ | $20$|$18 \redE{+{?}} =20$

What value for $\redE{?}$ makes all the equations true?

$x$ | $y$ | Difference
:-: | :-: | :-:
$32$ | $34$ |$32 \redE{+2} =34$
$25$ | $27$ |$25 \redE{+2} =27$
$18$ | $20$|$18 \redE{+2} =20$

The terms in pattern $y$ are $\redE{2}$ *more* than the terms in pattern $x$.

###Answer

The terms in pattern $y$ are $2$ more than the terms in pattern $x$.
